Review

A lecture's own self-check asks about what you have just read, which is the easiest condition there is. This asks later, and mixed — which is the condition that tells you whether you actually know it. Five minutes, eight questions.

Due now Only what your own answers say is worth revisiting. Limits that can be trusted Lectures 1–8, whether or not anything is due. What analyticity gives Lectures 9–14, whether or not anything is due. Maps and spectra Lectures 15–18, whether or not anything is due. Elliptic and theta functions Lectures 19–22, whether or not anything is due. Equations and boundary values Lectures 23–28, whether or not anything is due. Everything A mixed set from the whole course.

Where does this go? Nowhere. What you answer is kept in this browser and nothing else — no account, no marks, nothing sent anywhere. It follows you to another device only if you take the device.
